name: What is the difference between a kitchen layout redesign and a kitchen refresh?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a kitchen layout redesign and a kitchen refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen layout redesign changes how walls, plumbing, and electrical lines are arranged, which requires full architectural planning, demolition, and rough-in work before finishes are installed. A cosmetic update keeps appliances, sinks, and partition walls in place while updating finishes like paint, backsplash tile, or cabinet fronts. A complete layout reconfiguration involves structural assessments for open-concept conversions, relocating utility lines under subfloors, and framing new cabinet footprints, making it a more comprehensive construction project than a surface refresh.
acceptedAnswer.description: A layout redesign moves walls, sinks, appliances, and cabinetry footprints, whereas a refresh keeps the footprint identical and only replaces surface finishes.
